note: A `to` node that is not an end of its pass's arc (SPEC 3.3.3, valid-walk rule 3). Node a exists and the walk's spelling is right, so the only rule that separates this highlight from a valid one is that a node end is one of the arc's two ends. The diagnostic names the `to` key. `walk-from-not-an-end.vnx` pins the `from` half, and the two are separate because a reader can check one end and not the other.
